policy: Finite authored learning arcs. No automatic unit creation or quota of new lessons. Pilot units use four core, one transfer and one extra; future role allocation is an editorial decision.

coreOutcomes: Locate three notes on one string
Hear semitone versus whole tone with a shared root
Play a shifted three-note question
Count a silent beat
blueprints.terminalProject: Two-bar answer with one rest and a tonic ending
blueprints.optionalExtension: Play the motif on a second validated string
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: orientation and a steady gesture

coreOutcomes: Compare two unison routes
Cross two strings without overlapping notes
Outline C major as single notes
Choose a tonic or fifth ending
blueprints.terminalProject: Four bars with opening, breath and resolution
blueprints.optionalExtension: Contrast connected and separated articulation
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: orientation and a steady gesture

coreOutcomes: Locate shared notes in two pentatonic positions
Shift during a counted rest
Preserve one motif in two registers
Choose the smaller travel for a phrase
blueprints.terminalProject: Eight bars with two intentional position changes
blueprints.optionalExtension: Transpose one approved route to a nearby key
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one position, coordination or rhythmic constraint

coreOutcomes: Hear major and minor thirds from the same root
Play diatonic pairs with explicit hand shifts
Target E–F–B–E over C–Dm–G–C
Approach each third with one scale note
blueprints.terminalProject: Four-bar melodic answer with thirds as targets
blueprints.optionalExtension: Transfer to G–Am–D–G with approved physical routes
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one position, coordination or rhythmic constraint

coreOutcomes: Separate chord root from melodic target
Connect third and seventh between two chords
Prepare a chromatic neighbour without losing the target
Choose rests to expose the voice leading
blueprints.terminalProject: Eight-bar solo with traceable guide-tone motion
blueprints.optionalExtension: Compare two registers using the same voice line
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one harmonic or expressive decision at a time

coreOutcomes: Compare F and F# over a common C root
Keep the rhythmic motif constant across modes
Resolve characteristic notes deliberately
Choose one modal colour for a phrase
blueprints.terminalProject: A/B arrangement with one named colour decision
blueprints.optionalExtension: Reduce accompaniment and retain the audible modal identity
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one harmonic or expressive decision at a time

coreOutcomes: Place the root on beat one

blueprints.optionalExtension: Compare a single anticipation with an on-beat arrival
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: orientation and a steady gesture

coreOutcomes: Locate root third and fifth for one chord
Make the third audible without overfilling

blueprints.optionalExtension: Compare one fill in two registers

coreOutcomes: Count one offbeat entry with rests
Preserve bass note length through syncopation
Anticipate a change without a tempo jump
Choose when to leave beat four empty

blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one position, coordination or rhythmic constraint

coreOutcomes: Plan roots on harmonic changes
Choose chord tones on strong beats
Connect by diatonic and chromatic approach
Use register to preserve accompaniment clarity
blueprints.terminalProject: Eight-bar walking line with named arrivals
blueprints.optionalExtension: Rewrite one transition with less chromatic motion
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one harmonic or expressive decision at a time

coreOutcomes: Hear low versus middle register support
Use rests to leave room for melody
Compare a single tenth as optional colour
Choose a fill according to the next harmonic role

blueprints.optionalExtension: Remove the optional tenth and preserve the function
blueprints.dominantDifficulty: one harmonic or expressive decision at a time

coreOutcomes: Locate the five-finger region

coreOutcomes: Prepare thumb passage in one octave

coreOutcomes: Choose which strings carry melody
